caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden sign mounted between two vertical, turned wooden posts with decorative finials on top and bottom. The central panel of the sign is light brown with a weathered, woodgrain texture, and features a black silhouette of a horse facing right, with one front leg raised. Below the horse, the word "Entertainment" is printed in large black serif letters. The frame surrounding the panel and the posts are a dull, off-white or grayish color, with dark brown or black metal brackets or rods attached at the upper sides. The top edge of the sign panel is cut with a decorative, symmetrical arch and central point, while the bottom panel has two rounded curves cut inward, forming a concave design. The background is a plain light beige or off-white color.
title: Tavern Sign (Black Horse Tavern)
